moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-live-caption-block, written here): 2-line block (≤ 30 chars per line, 17 px bold) on an opaque dark box 268 × 50 px (radius 3) near the bottom. Blocks are replaced wholesale on a hard cut, no scroll or fade: demo 0.3–2.6 s and 2.6–4.9 s. Pacing: about 270 chars per minute measured on live TV (film guideline 240 per minute), so a block's time = its chars / 270 × 60 s. Optional LIVE tag (red dot + mono label) top-left. Loop 5.4 s. Params: tối đa (2 dòng × 30 ký tự) · nhịp (≈ 240–270 ký tự/phút) · nền (hộp tối).
